text:
Sofia (CSM): FYI — VeloxBiotics daily transactions dropped ~58% starting 2025-03-20. Renewal in ~7 weeks. New VP of Data (Anika) joined last week and procurement pinged for a vendor re-eval. :exclamation:
Kai (SE): Can you paste the route + org slug? Is it all projects or a single pipeline?
Sofia (CSM): Org: velox-prod. Hit from our metrics quickview:
```
2025-03-17  | requests: 15,400
2025-03-18  | requests: 15,100
2025-03-19  | requests: 15,000
2025-03-20  | requests: 6,300
2025-03-21  | requests: 6,200
```
Top drops: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings-batch.
Jordan (AE): Procurement said they're doing a cost bakeoff vs. competitor X and internal run-the-numbers. We should offer a short, focused deck: "stability + predictable spend" and a 60-90 day trial with committed burst.
Sofia (CSM): No spike in 401/5xx. Logs show no increased latency. SE says likely token rotation or role change removed service account access.
ops-bot: Onboarding checklist: last enabled feature-flags: analytics v3; last token rotation: 2025-02-01.
Kai (SE): OK — low-risk to fix if it's token. Two paths: 1) quick token restore (customer provides), or 2) rotate via our rotation flow (needs admin consent). Either should get them back to prior volume.
Sofia (CSM): Plan proposal: 1) 20-min triage with Anika + data lead (today), 2) restore access + validate top 3 jobs, 3) present 2-option commercial cushion: short reserved burst or temporary discount on top of current plan to cover re-run costs.
Jordan (AE): I'll prep a 1-pager and procurement Q&A. Also suggest a short metrics snapshot to show no reliability issues on our side. Can Legal fast-track a mini amendment?
Kai (SE): From infra: no regressions, no backend incidents. If they want a demo of cost/throughput tradeoffs, I can show batching/quantization impact for their batch pipeline.
Sofia (CSM): Action items: @Kai validate no infra ticket and prepare a 15-min demo snippet (due EOD), @Jordan draft 1-pager + procurement Q&A (due tomorrow), @Sofia schedule triage and invite Anika + data eng. I'll ping Anika via email and Slack.
Jordan (AE): I'll include a draft 60-day committed-burst term and price bands in the invite. If procurement pushes on TCO, offer a runbook for migration from competitor X to reduce lift.
Sofia (CSM): Draft outreach below, please review before I send:
"Hi Anika — congrats on the new role. We noticed a sharp drop in VeloxBiotics traffic that lines up with your team change and procurement check-in. Can we do a 20-min sync today to validate access and walk through two quick recovery paths? We can also put a short committed-burst in place while you evaluate options. — Sofia"
Kai (SE): LGTM. I'll be on the call and bring the batching demo.
ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4579 (VeloxBiotics usage drop). Priority: P2.
Sofia (CSM): Keeping thread live — will update after triage. :white_check_mark:
